name: bangladesh-study-abroad-dataset
title: Bangladesh Global Study Abroad Cost & Scholarship Dataset (2027)

sources.title: EduExpress China Study Data & Cost Benchmark API
EduExpress Bangladesh Study Abroad Market 2027 API

resources.name: universities_verified
resources.description: 416 verified active universities across 12 countries (China (353), Malaysia (15), United Kingdom (8), Finland (6), Hungary (6), South Korea (6), Cyprus (4), Georgia (4), Greece (4), Thailand (4), Croatia (3), Malta (3)) with CSC/English/Chinese-language flags, rankings, root official domains, and record counts.

resources.name: programs_verified
resources.description: 1974 structured degree and language programs with explicit tuition, duration, language, and verification dates.

resources.name: scholarships_verified
resources.description: 737 structured university scholarship tracks with parsed tuition waiver type/value, dorm/insurance waivers, and monthly stipends.

resources.name: itemized_fees_verified
resources.description: 1609 non-tuition and institutional fee rows (dorms, insurance, residence permit, EMGS, application fees).

resources.name: destinations_matrix_32_countries
resources.description: 32-country global Bangladesh outbound matrix covering tuition, living costs, 2026/27 statutory visa solvency thresholds, AD Bank Student File rules, and work rights.

resources.name: country_scholarships_verified
resources.description: 54 Bangladesh-eligible flagship government, regional, and institutional scholarships across 32 global destinations.

resources.name: china_study_report_2027
resources.description: Snapshot of EduExpress China study cost benchmark JSON API.

resources.name: bangladesh_study_abroad_market_2027
